title: Restore reloaded artifact repository registry global via monkeypatch in tests
answers: test fails only when run after test_standard_artifact_registry
artifact file-plugin scheme missing in later tests on some CI shards
how do I isolate a test that reloads the artifact registry module
pytest reload module global leaks into other tests
body:
Symptom: artifact-store tests that rely on installed plugin schemes (e.g. file-plugin) fail on some CI shards or only when run after another test, while passing in isolation.
Root cause: tests/store/artifact/test_artifact_repository_registry.py:test_standard_artifact_registry reloads the registry module with mocked entry points; the reload replaces the module global _artifact_repository_registry, so plugin registrations are lost for the rest of the worker's session.
Fix pattern: before any reload, snapshot the global with monkeypatch.setattr(module, "_artifact_repository_registry", module._artifact_repository_registry). monkeypatch restores the original object at teardown, even when the test fails.
Constraints: apply to any test that reloads or mutates a module-level registry; plain assignment without monkeypatch is not restored on failure. Reproduction in the PR was ordered (two tests, the reload first); the fix does not change production code.
applies: Test code under tests/store/artifact/ and other tests that reload or mutate module-level registries.
says: Automated continuous integration checks intermittently fail on artifact storage plugin tests across worker shards.
Storage plugin tests pass in isolation but fail when executed after registry tests in CI.
Pull request build fails because artifact storage plugin settings leak across sequential test runs.
Prevent registry test runs from breaking subsequent artifact plugin checks during continuous integration.
search: Isolating test reloads of the artifact repository registry module using monkeypatch.setattr. Before reloading or mutating a module-level registry in tests, snapshot the global _artifact_repository_registry with monkeypatch.setattr so original plugin registrations are restored at teardown. This prevents test_standard_artifact_registry in tests/store/artifact/test_artifact_repository_registry.py from leaking into subsequent tests and losing installed plugin schemes such as file-plugin on CI shards, leaving production code unchanged.
